title: The bird on the lamp, before the beach
logline: The green lamp on the drafting table, unlit, and the bird on its shade, the day before it's lit on the sand. The last page of the bird's sequence but one, in the book's order.

panels.composition: A green swing-arm desk lamp unlit on a drafting table with the small rainbow bird perched on its shade, a drawn page beneath, gray window light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a green swing-arm desk lamp unlit on a drafting table with a small rainbow bird perched on its shade and a drawn page beneath, gray window light, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
